answer: Random beacon checks plus a heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Joining locks a 40 unit bond and sends a heartbeat every ten minutes: a whisper of work timed by a quartz clock. Hourly the beacon picks 5%; a picked agent must reply in a minute, and two misses slash its bond. Faking 1,000 identities costs 40,000 units plus 1,000 streams above fake gains. An honest agent pays one bond and one stream and earns undiluted rewards even at the nadir of activity.
